title: The Young-Driver Share Carried Into a Keyturn Trip Booking Extension Quote
content:
Where a young-driver surcharge stands on a Keyturn Trip Booking reservation, a share of it is carried into the quote for the extra time, and how much of it is carried turns on the length of the extension.

1. Where a young-driver surcharge stands on the reservation and the extra time quoted runs to 2 days or more, the young-driver share is that surcharge spread evenly over the days of the reserved period and taken for each extended day, the share being brought to the nearest cent once the spreading and the taking have both been done and at no earlier step.
2. Where a young-driver surcharge stands on the reservation and the extra time quoted runs to less than 2 days, the young-driver share is that surcharge spread evenly over the days of the reserved period and taken for one day, the share being brought to the nearest cent once the spreading and the taking have both been done and at no earlier step.
3. In every other case no young-driver share is added.

### The surcharge read, and the days it is spread over

The surcharge spread is every young-driver surcharge line standing on the reservation taken together, as each was raised and whatever was afterwards done about it, so two such lines raised on different days are added together and a line since reversed or waived is counted as it was raised.

The days of the reserved period are counted from the first day of that period to the last, both days counted.

### Reading the ladder

| Young-driver surcharge standing on the reservation | Extended days the extra time runs to | The young-driver share |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 2 or more | The surcharge divided by the days of the reserved period, taken for each extended day. |
| Yes | Fewer than 2, that is 1 | The surcharge divided by the days of the reserved period, taken for one day. |
| No | Any | None. |

An extension of exactly 2 extended days meets the first row, since the figure is reached rather than passed. Where no young-driver surcharge stands on the reservation, no share is carried into the quote at all, whatever the length of the extension.

### Where the cent falls

*Hypothetical: a reservation whose reserved period runs 13 days carries a young-driver surcharge of 145.00 USD, and the extra time quoted runs to 2 extended days.* The spreading gives 11.153846… USD for each day of the reserved period. That figure is carried into the taking as it stands, and the cent is settled once the spreading and the taking have both been done and at no earlier step: 145.00 divided by 13 and taken for 2 extended days is 22.307692… USD, which comes to **22.31 USD**.

*The same reservation where the extra time quoted runs to 1 extended day.* The same daily figure is taken for one day: 11.153846… USD, which comes to **11.15 USD**.

*A reservation whose reserved period runs 20 days carrying a young-driver surcharge of 180.00 USD.* The spreading gives 9.00 USD for each day of the reserved period; an extension running to 3 extended days carries a young-driver share of 27.00 USD, and one running to 1 extended day carries 9.00 USD.
